target_customer: Gaming communities and esports teams needing chat with events, calendars and forums
problem: General chat tools lacked scheduling, forums and team features that organized gaming groups needed.
business_model: Free consumer chat platform with planned premium subscriptions

founders.name: Eli Brown
founders.background_notes: YC page: full stack and growth engineering, former YC visiting partner, later led Communities at Roblox. Education not found.

exit.reason: Roblox shut the product on 2025-12-19 to focus on Roblox Communities, as it stated on its developer forum.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time text and voice chat at scale plus calendars and forums is standard but demanding for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Communities have switching costs, yet Discord had the dominant network and could copy features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Discord kept dominating; Roblox bought Guilded in August 2021 and closed it in December 2025.

market_need_then: Organized gaming communities and esports teams needed scheduling and team tools beyond basic chat; Guilded first spread via World of Warcraft subreddit users (Wikipedia via search).

branding.domain_note: Used guilded.gg, a gaming oriented domain.

identity.logo: official brand color and light and dark logo variants exist

branding.community_and_virality: Users petitioned on Change.org to reverse the 2025 shutdown, showing a loyal base.

brand_strength.rationale: Loyal niche community and a fan petition, but never close to Discord's reach.

outcome_analysis: Guilded grew as a Discord alternative for organized gaming groups, raised a 7 million dollar Series A in April 2020 and sold to Roblox in August 2021 for about 77.6 million dollars per SEC filings. In 2024 Roblox required linked Roblox accounts, which press tied to falling activity, and the service closed on 19 December 2025. The exit paid investors but the product lost to a dominant incumbent and a parent that preferred its own communities.
notes: Exit type is acquisition, followed by shutdown in December 2025. Price 77.6M per Roblox 10-K; PocketGamer headlined 90M. Seed of about 3M in September 2017 appears only in aggregators (Seedtable, StartupIntros) so not recorded as a round. Total raised about 10M per aggregators. Competitor Discord launched 2015 but no source dated 2017 was found, so the list is empty. Founder education not found; website now redirects to Roblox Communities per press.
